verdict.rationale: Phaser is a code-first framework: games are written in JavaScript/TypeScript, scenes are built in code via create() and this.add calls, and projects install via npm. That implies plain-text, diffable source that fits normal git workflows. However, nothing in the pack documents version-control support, the Phaser Editor's scene file format or its mergeability, or any built-in multi-user collaboration. Missing for 10: documented diffable/mergeable editor scene format, version-control guidance, built-in team collaboration features, independent corroboration from teams.
